Where the dependencies come from

Source: R/deps.R
deps.Rd

The deps argument of dossier() says which versions of the package's dependencies both versions install and run against.

Usage

deps_shared()

deps_cran(repos = NULL)

deps_snapshot(date = NULL, repos = NULL)

Arguments

repos

Repository to install from. deps_cran() defaults to the CRAN entry of getOption("repos"), or the cloud mirror; deps_snapshot() to the dated Posit Package Manager URL. A given repository is used as is; for deps_snapshot(), versions that do not build are then taken from the same URL with latest in place of its date, and a URL without a date has no such fallback.

date

The snapshot's date ("2025-06-10", or a Date), overriding the baseline's release date. Set it for a baseline built here (a git ref or a folder), whose packaging date is today.

Value

An object of class pkgdossier_deps.

Details

  • deps_shared(): the dependencies in the current library paths, so differences come from the package alone.

  • deps_cran(): the current CRAN versions of every dependency of both versions (Depends, Imports and LinkingTo, recursively) are installed into a library in the work folder, as a new user installing today would get them. prepare_versions() installs them, and reinstalls one when the repository has a newer version.

  • deps_snapshot(): the versions CRAN had on the baseline's release date (its Date/Publication, else the day it was packaged, or date), from Posit Package Manager's dated snapshots, installed the same way. Differences then come from the package's own changes rather than from changes in its dependencies since its release; a baseline that fails with today's dependencies (a removed function, a changed C interface) runs as its users had it. A candidate that needs newer dependencies than the snapshot has stops with a clear message. A snapshot older than the R running it can hold versions that no longer build (R removes C entry points over time); those are installed at their current version, and prepare_versions() and versions.json (newer_than_snapshot) say which. For a faithful snapshot, run on an R from the baseline's time.

With deps_cran() and deps_snapshot(), R's base and recommended packages are used as installed, and packages the scenarios use that are not dependencies (a vignette's suggested packages) come from the current library paths. Their libraries in the work folder are kept per R minor version (lib-deps-R4.6, lib-deps-2025-06-10-R4.6), so the same work folder used under another R installs them afresh.

Examples

deps_shared()
#> <pkgdossier deps> shared, from the current library paths
deps_cran()
#> <pkgdossier deps> current CRAN versions, in the work folder
deps_snapshot("2025-06-10")
#> <pkgdossier deps> CRAN as on 2025-06-10, in the work folder
